source.name: HSK/HT NDA official project website, Development Blueprint

why: Brief task 9 asks for three real published plans encoded as scenarios, so we are testing real plans rather than something we invented.

CEDD publishes works areas as hectares per contract. It does NOT publish a land-use allocation, a developable-area total, or any flood-storage volume; the HSK EIA deliberately defers retention volumes.

So the published number is a works footprint and is used as exactly that: an area of land being formed. What that land becomes is not published, so the land-cover conversion is an explicit assumption of this project, labelled per scenario, and the spatial layout is assumed contiguous with existing development because no layout is published.

scenarios.label: First Phase as published
scenarios.source: Development Blueprint: Advance Works Phases 1 & 2 (about 3 ha and about 2.6 ha) plus Stage 1 Works (about 14 ha)
scenarios.assumptionNote: Site formation for a first phase of public and private housing with community facilities. The 80/20 split is this project's assumption; CEDD publishes no land-use allocation.

scenarios.label: Second Phase Stage 2 Works as published
scenarios.source: Development Blueprint: Second Phase Stage 2 Works, about 200 ha
scenarios.assumptionNote: The largest single published works area, about 200 ha. The 70/30 split is this project's assumption and is greener than the first phase because the Second Phase is larger and includes a Green Transit Corridor.

scenarios.label: Second Phase, all six main works contracts
scenarios.source: Development Blueprint: YL/2023/01 (about 30 ha), /02 (about 8.5 ha, fresh-water service reservoir), /03 (about 50 ha), /04 (about 43 ha), /05 (about 60 ha), /06 (about 62 ha)
scenarios.assumptionNote: The six Second Phase main works contracts as listed. The components may overlap in extent -- CEDD publishes no reconciliation -- so the total is the sum of the published contract areas and is an upper bound on distinct land.
